responsibility: Declares the public crate-level entry point for the Rust borrow-checking pass. The BorrowChecker class exposes a go(HIR::Crate&) driver and stores the flag controlling optional BIR dump emission, making this header the small interface to the borrow-check pipeline rather than the location of BIR lowering, fact extraction, or Polonius integration details.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public BorrowChecker driver class for the borrowck module, exposing go(HIR::Crate&) and the dump-control flag; unlike the companion .cc file, it does not perform collection, BIR construction, dumping, or fact extraction.
